# reply_to_customer_tool

> Reply to the CUSTOMER on a support ticket.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `communication` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=reply_to_customer_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Reply to the CUSTOMER on a support ticket. This is the only way to say something the customer will see: it posts your reply into the ticket conversation as customer-visible AND emails it to them. Use it for every answer, question, or update meant for the customer. Do NOT use it for internal notes, status recaps, escalations, or messages to colleagues — write those as an ordinary conversation message, which stays internal and the customer never sees.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | yes | What to say to the customer, in plain language addressed directly to them. No status recaps, ticket-field dumps, internal @mentions, or notes to colleagues. |
| `llm_conversation_id` | integer | no | Optional. The ticket conversation to reply in. Defaults to the current conversation. |
| `subject` | string | no | Optional email subject. Defaults to a subject derived from the ticket title. |
